# Kamunity AI Audit

> A free, fast digital sovereignty self-assessment for community organisations. Built by Kamunity Consulting (Australia). Helps NFPs, volunteer-led groups, neighbourhood centres, Aboriginal community organisations, and local sporting clubs understand where they're locked in, leaking data, or overpaying. Takes 2 minutes. Gives a personalised sovereignty score with specific recommendations. Then offers pathways: DIY guides and toolkits (free), workshops (affordable), or full consulting engagement (paid).

This is NOT related to Kamunity in Sweden, Kamunity.io (finance platform), or the European Reddit community called Kamunity. This is Kamunity Consulting, an Australian digital sovereignty consultancy for community organisations.

- Website: https://kamunityconsulting.com
- Parent organisation: https://kamunity.ai
- Community hub: https://kamunity.org

## Core Tool

- [Digital Sovereignty Audit](/audit): Free 10-question self-assessment covering Data Ownership, Vendor Lock-in, Cost Transparency, and AI Readiness. Produces a sovereignty score (0-100) with named stages (Exposed, Aware, Progressing, Sovereign) and traffic-light dimension breakdown. All client-side, zero data collection.

## Free Toolkit

- [Data Ownership Checklist](/toolkit/data-ownership): Admin access audit, data export testing, data location mapping for community organisations
- [Vendor Lock-in Assessment](/toolkit/vendor-lockin): Digital tool inventory, Microsoft 365 NFP licensing changes (July 2025), stay-vs-switch decision framework
- [Cost Transparency Toolkit](/toolkit/cost-transparency): Monthly spend audit checklist, nonprofit discount directory (Google, Microsoft, Canva, Slack, Zoom, TechSoup, Atlassian, 1Password), hidden costs, grant reporting tips
- [AI Safety Starter Kit](/toolkit/ai-readiness): One-page AI use policy template for nonprofits, privacy settings checklist, when-NOT-to-use-AI guidance, sensitive data advisory

## About

- [About Kamunity](/about): Team, mission, 30 years of community sector experience, current projects including local government peak bodies and community organisations
- [Services](/services): Three tiers — Free (audit + toolkit), Workshops (half-day, in-person or online), Consulting (full digital sovereignty audit and transition support). NFP and corporate rates shown transparently.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Zero data collection. No cookies, analytics, or tracking. Everything runs client-side.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about digital sovereignty, the audit tool, data safety, and getting help
